paper_title: New axion and hidden photon constraints from a solar data global fit
suggested_experiment_name: Solar helioseismology and neutrino flux constraints on axion-photon coupling
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling constant
notes: Paper presents a new solar constraint on axion-photon coupling from a global statistical fit combining helioseismology (sound speed, surface helium, convective radius) and solar neutrino observations (8B and 7Be fluxes). The limit g_agamma < 4.1 × 10^-10 GeV^-1 at 3σ CL is stated in the abstract and confirmed in Section 4.4. This is a mass-independent bound valid for hadronic (KSVZ) axions and axion-like particles. The paper also constrains hidden photons with χm < 1.8 × 10^-12 eV, but the primary new result emphasized is the axion-photon coupling.
